messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — HeliosPay just tripped a usage alert. Daily request volume collapsed ~72% over the last 7 days. Renewal in ~6 weeks and procurement swapped contacts last week (new procurement lead: Lina Ortega). @Ravi can you pull last 30d token metrics? :eyes:
Ravi Singh: On it. grabbing metrics now. curious if it's seat churn or just API calls down. any notes from onboarding?
Maya Chen: Onboarding looks complete. They did a training in Jan, but adoption never expanded beyond the payments team. I pinged customer PM, they said exec roadmap shifted and procurement is re-evaluating vendors (mentioned "NimbusAI" by name).
Evan Brooks: Could be a competitive pilot. If Nimbus is cheaper on high-throughput, they might be testing. We should check if they've opened a trial on our Dedicated offering or asked for pricing.
Priya Nair: Also saw a flagged billing contact change — finance contact moved to a shared mailbox. @finance-bot can you confirm invoice status?
finance-bot: Invoice status: 1 unpaid invoice (30 days past due). Last payment: 2025-11-02. Billing contact: billing@heliospay.com (updated 2026-02-10).
Maya Chen: Not ideal. Unpaid invoice + procurement swap = increased risk. We should coordinate a renewal triage. Proposed play: 1) Quick health check + tailored enablement for new teams 2) Exec QBR with new procurement+finance 3) Offer 4-week pilot pricing or dedicated POC to match Nimbus pricing on throughput.
Ravi Singh: Metrics snapshot I pulled:
```
30d requests: 24,300 -> 6,740 (72% drop)
Active seats: 18 -> 16
Top route traffic: /v1/chat (down 68%)
Prefetch/cache hit: unchanged
```
Looks like fewer integration calls rather than seats.
Evan Brooks: That aligns with a competitor API test. Recommend: trigger a short intercept survey to product users + offer a "migration rollback" playbook if they test Nimbus. I can draft a 30-min enablement for payments engineers.
Jordan Lee: I'll reach out to Lina and ask for a short sync — low-commit ask: 15 min to understand evaluation criteria. If pricing is the blocker we can propose a limited-duration throughput credit.
Maya Chen: Action items:
- Jordan: outbound to Lina + get competitor details (due: 2026-03-18)
- Evan: draft 30-min enablement + one-pager showing latency/cost delta (due: 2026-03-17)
- Ravi: baseline metrics export + any recent error spikes (due: 2026-03-16)
- Priya: prep renewal timeline + confirm billing hold details with finance (due: 2026-03-16)
- Maya: schedule exec QBR tentatively for w/c 2026-03-23 and own follow-up
Please react with :thumbsup: when you own something.
Priya Nair: Confirming I'll work with finance to unstick invoice and flag commercial contact. Will also include org chart for procurement.
Jordan Lee: Reaching out now, will post notes here.
account-bot: Calendar: Tentative QBR created for 2026-03-24 16:00 PDT. Invite sent to Maya, Jordan, Lina Ortega (pending acceptance).
Maya Chen: Good. Also capturing feedback loop: if they say performance/cost is the reason, we should propose Redwood Optimize assessment (free, 2-week). Evan drop me the one-pager and I'll include it in the outreach.
Evan Brooks: Will do. Draft incoming by EOD tomorrow.
Ravi Singh: Export uploaded: https://redwood.internal/exports/heliospay-30d-3344509876.csv
Maya Chen: Thanks team — let's push to convert discovery into a short POC rather than letting them drift. Will update after Jordan's convo. :rocket:
